actors.name: Sintel
actors.bio_snippet: Determined tracker searching across barren lands to recover her abducted dragon.

actors.name: The Shaman
actors.bio_snippet: An enigmatic elder dwelling in the arid wasteland who warns Sintel of the dragon's mountain.

timeline.trivia_fact: Character rigging for Sintel introduced advanced procedural facial deformation systems to Blender 2.5.
timeline.plot_summary: Sintel confronts the ancient Shaman in the desert ruins, receiving foreboding omens regarding the perilous mountain ascent.

timeline.soundtrack: BBC Philharmonic - Symphony of the Pelagic Abyss
timeline.trivia_fact: Filmed in 8K HDR at 4,000 meters depth using specialized pressure-sealed optical quartz domes.
timeline.plot_summary: Submersible expedition documents infrasonic whale vocalizations and discovers pristine deep-water kelp sanctuaries.

actors.name: Bioluminescent Siphonophore

timeline.soundtrack: Brian Eno - Pelagic Drift (Ambient Spatial Audio)
timeline.trivia_fact: Siphonophores in the Mariana Trench coordinate thousands of specialized zooids to hunt in absolute darkness.
timeline.plot_summary: Descending into the aphotic midnight zone, exploring alien bioluminescent colonies and hydrothermal vents.

actors.name: Captain Mateo Cruz

actors.name: Ana Torres
actors.bio_snippet: Researcher tracking humpback whale nursery grounds along the Pacific ridge.

timeline.trivia_fact: Filmed around the Marino Ballena National Park, renowned for its naturally formed whale-tail sandbar.
timeline.plot_summary: Sailing through crystalline Pacific shoals as humpback mothers nurse calves in protected tropical estuaries.
